# Migrating to App Stylr v1.2.0

This compatible visual update adds `radius.button` (9px), exposed as `--radius-button` in CSS and `AppStylrTokens.Radius.button` in Swift. Existing 8px control, 12px card, and 16px dialog tokens remain available. No public semantic role or package export is removed.

Dark canvas, surface, text, and border values now use neutral charcoal. The mint accent and light theme colors are unchanged. Strong dark borders have more contrast for controls; decorative panel borders remain subtle.

1. Pin the approved immutable source revision, or the matching version tag once published.
2. Refresh the generated adapters and Reference artifact. Do not edit generated files.
3. Use `--radius-button` for buttons when adopting the refined corners; input fields can keep `--radius-control`.
4. Compare supported themes, control boundaries, focus indicators, and text contrast across desktop and phone layouts.

The Reference is an example composition. Product heroes, navigation, animation, and page layouts remain product-owned. Updating main prepares source only; tagging and npm publication are separate release steps.
